entries.external_finding: kimi-enriched: AT-218 partial (not truly different codepaths)
entries.reason: False positive. test_at218_two_codepaths_same_hash constructs two independent struct instances with identical field values. The AT-218 requirement is 'two codepaths compute the same intent fields -> hashes identical.' The test directly implements this. R1 verdict PROVEN is correct.

entries.external_finding: kimi-generic: P1 missing input validation for negative qty/prices
entries.reason: False positive. The hash function is a pure computation over all i64 values. Negative validation is the upstream quantization layer's responsibility (S2-000). The hash function should not reject inputs. R1 Section 5 (Fail-Closed) correctly classified negative values as N/A.
Duplicate of kimi-enriched P3 finding on same function. Lower-severity version already captured. Not a gap -- naming is accurate (xxhash64 = 64 bits = 16 hex chars).

gaps.description: AT-201 misattributed to S2-001. AT-201 is about intent classification (unknown action -> OPEN), not hashing. AT-201 is tested in test_reject_reason.rs under a different story.
gaps.action: Remove AT-201 from S2-001 enforcing_contract_ats in plans/prd.json.
gaps.fix_citation: AT-201 removed from enforcing_contract_ats and primary_owner_for in prd.json

gaps.description: AT-928 WAL dedup not enforceable by S2-001. S2-001 provides the hash function prerequisite but does not implement WAL lookup/NOOP logic. No end-to-end dedup test exists within S2-001 scope.
gaps.action: Verify AT-928 is owned and tested in the WAL integration story. If no story owns AT-928, create debt entry with owner assignment.

gaps.description: compute_intent_hash has zero production callers in src/. The function is defined, exported, and thoroughly tested, but not called from any production code path. PROVEN-UNIT, not PROVEN-INTEGRATED.
gaps.action: Verify a downstream story (label generation, WAL integration) calls compute_intent_hash from production code. Document the expected integration point.

gaps.description: PRD implementation_tests lists only 1 test (test_at218_deterministic_hash) but 14 tests exist in test_idempotency.rs plus adversarial tests. The PRD understates coverage.
gaps.action: Update PRD implementation_tests to list all proving tests, or document that test_idempotency.rs is the proving suite.
gaps.fix_citation: implementation_tests updated from 1 entry to 16 entries (all tests in test_idempotency.rs)

gaps.description: PRD reason_codes for S2-001 lists LabelTooLong, but LabelTooLong is defined in label.rs (S2-002 domain). S2-001's hash.rs does not produce any reject reasons.
gaps.action: Remove LabelTooLong from S2-001 reason_codes in plans/prd.json (or set to empty).
gaps.fix_citation: reason_codes.values set to empty array in prd.json

gaps.description: No golden vector test exists to anchor the hash algorithm as xxhash64 with seed=0. A wrong implementation using std::collections::hash_map::DefaultHasher, xxhash32, or any other deterministic hash would pass all current tests. Premortem S5 (FM-6, FM-7) identified this gap and S6 proof plan calls for a golden vector test.
gaps.action: Add test_golden_vector_xxhash64: compute hash of known input, assert it matches a pre-computed xxhash64 reference value. This anchors the algorithm choice.
gaps.fix_citation: test_golden_vector_xxhash64 added: asserts compute_intent_hash(sample_input()) == 7179042994956709649 and hex == 63a1159155a6af11

gaps.description: No explicit test verifies the hash ignores non-canonical fields. While the struct type system provides compile-time enforcement (IntentHashInput has exactly 6 fields), no test documents that strat_id, reduce_only, exchange_name, etc. are excluded. Adding such fields to the struct would silently change hash behavior without failing any existing test except the struct exhaustiveness test.
gaps.action: Add test_hash_ignores_non_canonical_fields: compile-time assertion that IntentHashInput has exactly the 6 canonical fields. The existing test_at343_no_timestamp_field partially covers this, but a dedicated non-canonical field exclusion test would be stronger documentation. Alternatively, document the existing struct exhaustiveness test as the canonical-field gate.
gaps.fix_citation: test_hash_uses_only_canonical_fields added: struct literal exhaustiveness + size_of assertion (72 bytes = exactly 6 canonical fields)
